verdicts.reason: A is a shrunken copy of the square layout centred on the wide canvas: the SOLSTICE logo and wordmark are tiny, the subhead and CTA text are small for the size, a visible dark panel box sits awkwardly behind the copy, and both sides are left as dead space. B rearranges the design into a real banner with a large headline on the left and the can on the right, but it has clear flaws: the logo straddles the top edge of the text panel, the panel bleeds off the left edge, and the oversized CTA pill is jammed under the subhead with almost no bottom padding, so it competes with the headline.
